title: GraphEdge
description: One relationship in the deterministically generated PROGRAM-003 Knowledge Graph index. Every GraphEdge must be derived from a real field on a real authoritative record -- the builder never invents a relationship to complete the taxonomy. RELATED_TO is intentionally excluded from edgeType: it is the ambiguous, catch-all relationship this design explicitly avoids. Rebuilding from unchanged source files must reproduce byte-identical GraphEdge records.

generated.description: Always true. Marks this record as a build artifact, never as an authoritative research record.

edgeId.description: Format: EDGE|{EDGE_TYPE}|{fromEntityId}|{toEntityId}. If the raw concatenation of both entity ids would exceed 200 characters, the builder truncates each entity id to its first 40 characters and appends '~' + the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256({edgeType}|{fromEntityId}|{toEntityId}) -- see scripts/trader_intelligence/build_graph.py:make_edge_id for the exact algorithm. This keeps ids readable while remaining collision-resistant and fully deterministic.

evidenceIds.description: Populated for evidentiary edge types (SUPPORTS, EVIDENCES, CONTRADICTS, VALIDATES, RESOLVES, PARTIALLY_RESOLVES); left empty for structural edges (BELONGS_TO_TRADER, SEGMENT_OF, VERSION_OF, etc.).

confidenceDimensions.description: Present only when the underlying relationship itself carries confidence (e.g. a SUPPORTS edge copies the source assertion's interpretationConfidence). Never invented for structural edges. UNKNOWN must never be substituted for an absent value -- absence is represented as null, not as a confidence level.

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative path of the authoritative record whose field produced this edge.
